claim: Gating costly transductive test generation on low inductive agreement cuts average cost from $0.077 to $0.065 while keeping reranking quality.
stance_target: L3: confidence-allocated test-time compute has a code-reranking occupant, narrowly scoped to test-output synthesis
scope_conditions: HumanEval-R+ and MBPP-R+, single LLM, Table 1
quoted_support: Compared with TT w/o Gating, CoTT reduces the average inference cost from $0.077 to $0.065
